title: External testing: Docker environment, E2E scenarios, CI integration
description:
Implement external testing infrastructure from docs/plans/17-external-testing.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Key deliverables:
- Docker test environment: multi-stage Dockerfile (minimal/gvisor/full targets)
- Docker Compose with profile-based services (sandbox-host-minimal/gvisor/full)
- Usage example code: All Local, Agent in Sandbox, Agent outside Sandbox
- E2E test scenarios across all placement modes
- Backend config combination tests (C1-C4)
- CI tier integration (PR-fast mock-based, PR-standard Docker, Nightly dedicated)
- Test helpers: requireZFS, requireGVisor, sandboxHostConfig
- Build tag gating (docker, native, provider_integration)

Depends on: T1 (configurable backends must exist first)

AC: Docker-based E2E tests run for minimal config, all placement modes tested, CI tiers defined.
